summary: Megan Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held July 13, 2026. Shareholders approved three proposals: a share consolidation of up to 1-for-400, amendments to the memorandum and articles reducing notice periods for meetings (from 10 to 5 clear days) and postal service (from 5 to 2 calendar days). No forced CEO/CFO/board departure is mentioned. The filing is a routine meeting report, not a special situation; however, category ‘Management Changes’ is selected under coding guidelines for abrupt departures, but none occurred. Recommend ‘None’ instead.
